verdict.rationale: Gladia is an API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question, but the evidence pack shows none. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt docs index, CLI and MCP server are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
